title: MyConstant Loan Matching Service begins operating
description: MyConstant began offering an online loan-matching service in which customer funds were pooled and managed through the platform, alongside later crypto and fiat interest-account products.
notes: The SEC describes the service as starting in or around May 2019; the first day of the month is used as an approximate sortable date.

title: MyConstant pauses deposits and customer withdrawals
description: MyConstant stopped processing deposits and investment requests and paused customer withdrawals while citing deteriorating crypto-market conditions and heavy withdrawals across lending and exchange platforms.
notes: The halt was publicly acknowledged by California regulators and later described in the SEC administrative order.

title: MyConstant ceases normal operations
description: The platform ceased normal business operations on the same date as the withdrawal halt and remained inactive afterward.
notes: This operational-end classification follows the SEC finding that MyConstant ceased operations in November 2022 and remained inactive.

title: MyConstant announces orderly liquidation plan
description: MyConstant informed customers that it intended to implement an orderly liquidation intended to maximize and accelerate customer recoveries.
notes: This was a company-announced liquidation path rather than a conventional bankruptcy filing recorded by CYA.

title: California orders MyConstant to stop unlawful offerings
description: The California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation ordered CONST LLC to stop violations connected with its loan-brokering and interest-bearing crypto and fiat products.
notes: The order followed the platform halt and did not itself establish a universal customer recovery outcome.

title: Court grants preliminary approval to customer class settlement
description: A Riverside County court granted preliminary approval to a proposed class settlement built around a liquidating trust, pro rata customer distributions, and an additional payment by MyConstant's founder.
notes: The settlement website continued to describe the arrangement as subject to final court approval; CYA does not classify the proposed distribution as completed repayment.

title: SEC imposes cease-and-desist order on MyConstant founder
description: The SEC entered a settled order finding material misrepresentations, misuse and misappropriation of investor funds, and securities-law violations connected with MyConstant's Loan Matching Service.
notes: The respondent consented to the order without admitting or denying most findings, while admitting jurisdiction and specified bankruptcy-discharge findings.
